name: Time-of-check / time-of-use depends on distributed lock provider

input.title: Balance check + debit may race if distributed lock is unavailable
input.summary: Code path uses Redis SETNX with 5s TTL. If Redis is down, code falls back to no-lock. We don't know whether the fallback has ever been triggered in production telemetry.

rationale: Hinges on Redis availability. Needs chaos-test reproduction. Stays needs_validation.
